notes.title: Changes/Patch/Update on Banzai Escape
notes.notes:
Changes/Patch/Update on Banzai Escape 8 March 2020

Changes:
+Mp5 and Pistol now can do minor damage on Centurion core
+Laser room are now control using keyboard AWSD keys
+Slight changes to graphic appearance.

Added:
+Added hidden funder and missing voice actor into credits

Fixed:
+Physic hair fixed
+Fixed timer issues on vsync or non-vsync PC

notes.title: Almost like free! But Dont Want It Free!
notes.notes:
Hello Every Nyan!

What a good day today! 
Since Banzai Escape 2 launched a week ago, we decided to make an awesome discount for Banzai Escape 1 game! 

So why is it now?
Well some people probably don't know the story behind of Rokiahi mission, so this is a good chance to get to know about it before jumping into Banzai Escape 2. To some people who already play it, it might a good way to share the game to others as gift :)

Well Why not just make a free weekend play? 
Well we are small company, we need to survive this harsh world too ya know! Although its fees almost like no profits, at least its help us a bit when lots of people playing / replaying it.

The most important, SHARE IT TO OTHERS!

Thanks 
Aisam

notes.title: Banzai Escape 2 Released!
notes.notes:
Good Day Everyone!

Today is a great day to celebrate!

Today is the day of Banzai Escape 2 released!
After taking about 4 years long development and developed with mostly about 2-3 peoples and now we managed to release it to the world!

Here's the game store page!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1230990/Banzai_Escape_2/

Thank you for all of you who are supporting us back then till now!
And We are sorry for lacking lots of news. The development took hell of our time in developing this game.
-But We consider this game as our grand masterpieces! We give lots of sweat on creating it!
Hope You Guys Will Enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/0752656a5ebf43d030496a992417636bc7cf7fed.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/e1c7d0bbb9fbcd81c595221503bb598bf8d21245.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/759bb105c390be17eba29d7d7d86e5f4dedae5e1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/39577a9f3f3d39516b2c01f50a5fb1f7cf688102.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/3f5dc155b98e5b5de000dc55417c34167ff0f6a1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/858f9e7b539afc95d6714d39357211c938796144.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/35794c1accfb82091a61c3ebd5ed5beaa394c31b.jpg[/img]

Yes! Nothing is perfect! Because our team is small, we are lacking man-powers and resource (money of course) to perfecting this game! So, expecting you will encounter some minor bugs. But we confident there’s no major bugs that make it unplayable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/233ae7d52e46aad968234bac00ca7cfbb1280b3f.png[/img]

And there’s more!
We also in process of integrating this game to the STEAM WORKSHOP!
Mod is fully functional, and there’s a tool inside game directory to allow player to start mod-ing. Sadly, no tutorial or documentation yet! But feel free to asking us, especially me (XenoAisam) on chat group on how to mod-ing

Banzai Escape 2 Chat Group:
https://s.team/chat/YHfk9pky

No STEAM achievement? Don’t worry! We will integrate it in the future when the times comes! We hope you guy will play it and get the fun to the bottom of your heart! 

Thank you once again!
AND PLEASE SHARE ABOUT THIS GAME TO OTHERS!

Aisam :)

notes.title: New Banzai Escape Voice & Many More
notes.notes:
Banzai Escape has gone through massive updated. Now the game have new items, one of it:

[h1]"VOICE FOR DIALOGUE"[/h1]

Player are now able to listen to newly add voice for dialogues. Unfortunately it's only English for now.

As Usual, voice also can be "MOD-ED"!

Voices got 2 options, one is English and another is Null (no voice).
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/440340/extras/20160411224623_1.jpg[/img]

Other update is new Graphic Quality Option is added:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/440340/extras/20160411224623_1.jpg[/img]

Sound control are now with more options:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/440340/extras/20160411224643_1.jpg[/img]

After looking at several player gameplay, Banzai Escape has now put scroll bar to make the browsing easier:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/440340/extras/20160411224717_1.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/440340/extras/20160411224736_1.jpg[/img]

Thank you for playing and supporting this game ːBwinkː

notes.title: Banzai Escape Japanese
notes.notes:
Banzai Escapeは日本語字幕に対応しています。
最初の画面から"OPTIONS"を選択します。
"LAUNGUAGE"を選択します。
少し読み込みに時間が掛かりますが、
"LAUNGUAGE DIALOGUE"が出てきます。
下向き矢印から"日本語"を選んでください。
日本語字幕で遊べるようになります。

by SuperLolipopCandy
